Placemaker.Mode.Draw.Tooltip: Click corners. Snaps to curbs, buildings and right angles.
Placemaker.Mode.Block.Tooltip: Click a city block to fill it. Shift+click adds more.
Placemaker.Mode.Paint.Tooltip: Brush it on, freely (Smart edges off). Shift+drag erases, right-click starts over.
Placemaker.Mode.Perimeter.Tooltip: Click road corners around the area; the roads between are followed.
Placemaker.Mode.BlockPaint.Tooltip: Brush it on; it stops at roads, buildings, zoning and water (Smart edges). Shift+drag erases, right-click starts over.
Placemaker.Painter.Name: Outgrow
Placemaker.Painter.Desc: Join up the outgrows of the houses you pick, or put them back as the game made them.
Placemaker.Painter.CityPolishing: Outgrowing the whole city, a few buildings at a time
Placemaker.Painter.CityUnpolishing: Removing outgrow from the whole city, a few hundred at a time
Placemaker.Painter.Paused: Outgrow is switched off for this city: they outgrow once you switch it back on
Placemaker.Problem.TooManyPoints: That is the most corners an outline can have.
Placemaker.Problem.NeedThreePoints: An area needs at least three corners.
Placemaker.Problem.TooSmallFor: Too small for this design (at least {0} m²).
Placemaker.Problem.TooLargeFor: Too large for this design (at most {0} m²).
Placemaker.Problem.OnOtherBuild: This outline lies on another Placemaker build. Move it, or turn off the brush rule "Other builds".
Placemaker.Problem.NoBlockHere: No block could be found here.
Placemaker.Problem.BlockFull: Nothing to paint in this block: it is zoned, built on or under water.
Placemaker.Problem.CannotPaintHere: Nothing can be painted here: it is a road, zoned, built on or under water.
Placemaker.Problem.NoRoadsNearby: No roads nearby. Use Draw or Paint here.
Placemaker.Problem.NotEnclosed: Not enclosed here. Turn on more walls (paths, tracks…) or use Points.
Placemaker.Problem.BlockTooLarge: This block is too large to pick. Use Draw or Paint.
Placemaker.Problem.NotAdjacent: Only blocks next to the selection can be added.
Placemaker.Problem.WouldEncloseHole: Areas cannot have holes: that would enclose a block you did not pick.
Placemaker.Problem.WouldSplit: Removing that block would split the selection in two.
Placemaker.Problem.PerimeterClosed: The loop is closed. Undo (Ctrl+Z) reopens it.
Placemaker.Problem.NoRoadPath: These intersections are not connected by roads.
Placemaker.Problem.NodeAlreadyUsed: The loop already passes through there.
Placemaker.Problem.SaveFailed: The design could not be saved.
Placemaker.Problem.CannotDeleteRecipe: Only your own designs can be deleted.
Placemaker.Problem.PresetSaveFailed: The preset could not be saved.
Placemaker.Problem.CannotRenamePreset: Only your own presets can be renamed.
Placemaker.Problem.CannotEdit: This area cannot be edited (its design was not stored).
Placemaker.Hint.BlockReplace: Click elsewhere to fill there instead
Placemaker.Hint.MarkerRemove: Right-click: take back the last one
Placemaker.Hint.DefaultsSaved: Saved as the default for this layer.
Placemaker.Hint.Ungrouped: Ungrouped: click its pieces one by one.
Placemaker.Hint.Grouped: Grouped again: one click selects all of it.
Placemaker.Issue.PlanFailed: The layout could not be planned: {0}
Placemaker.Issue.PlanTimeout: Planning took longer than {0} s and was stopped. Try a smaller area.
Placemaker.Issue.KeptOffRoads: The area was trimmed to keep off existing roads ({0} m² left out).
Placemaker.Issue.AreaSplitByRoad: A road runs through the area: the largest part is used, {0} smaller part(s) ({1} m²) left out. Select them separately if you want them too.
Placemaker.Issue.BuildFailedNext: Red circles show where it went wrong. Adjust the outline or the settings and build again, or go back. The circles disappear as soon as you change something.
Placemaker.Permanent.Terraform: Reshapes the ground (about {0} m²). This stays even if you remove the build later.
Placemaker.Permanent.Water: Digs a pond or lake (about {0} m²). The hollow stays even if you remove the build later.
On: outgrown buildings join up with their neighbours: one plot each, shared fences and hedges, lawns or painted ground up to them, planting, paths and outgrow features by theme. Off: nothing is changed from now on; outgrows already outgrown stay as they are (Remove all outgrow puts them back). Switching it on never redoes the whole city.
Placemaker.Settings.PolishStatus.Desc: How many buildings in this city are outgrown, and what is still being worked on. Changing a setting below never changes the whole city at once: new buildings get it, the painter (Outgrow in Placemaker) gives it to an area, and Redo outgrown buildings gives it to every outgrown building, a few at a time.
Placemaker.Settings.PolishStatus.NoCity: Open a city to see how many buildings are outgrown.
Placemaker.Settings.PolishStatus.Working: working through {0:N0}, a few at a time
Placemaker.Settings.PolishStatus.Changed: settings changed: new buildings get them, Redo outgrown buildings gives them to the rest
Outgrows every house, shop, office and works already standing in this city (not the kinds set to Off), each with its kind's theme. It runs in the background a few buildings at a time, so the game keeps running smoothly; in a big city it takes a few minutes. Remove all outgrow puts it back.
Outgrow every building in this city?
Placemaker.Settings.RedoPolishedBuilding: Fits every outgrown building again with the settings above and gives it its kind's theme (buildings you gave a theme with the painter keep it). It runs in the background a few buildings at a time.
Redo every outgrown building with these settings?
Placemaker.Settings.PolishNewHouses.Desc: Buildings that grow from now on are outgrown, each with its kind's theme below. Off: they stay as the game made them. Buildings already standing: Outgrow every building below, or Outgrow in Placemaker for an area.
Placemaker.Settings.RemoveAllPolish.Desc: Puts every outgrow in this city back as the game made it: fences, hedges and lawns go back, and the beds, paths, bushes and paving that outgrow added are taken away. Ground paint stays. It runs in the background a few hundred buildings at a time.
Placemaker.Settings.RemoveAllPolish.Warn: Put every outgrow back as the game made it?
Placemaker.Settings.PolishThemeHomes.Des: How the outgrows of homes are dressed when they are outgrown. Garden: lawns, beds, now and then a sand pit or a bench. Natural: painted ground instead of lawn, rock outcrops, logs, meadow. Tidy: lawns, hedges and flower beds, no rocks. Yard: worn ground, rubble, pallets and crates. Off: new homes are not outgrown. The painter can give any house its own theme. A change is given to homes outgrown from now on; Redo outgrown buildings gives it to the ones already outgrown.
Placemaker.Settings.PolishThemeShops.Des: How shops are dressed when outgrown (the gaps between them are paved with their own paving whatever the theme). Off: new shops are not outgrown. A change is given to shops outgrown from now on; Redo outgrown buildings gives it to the ones already outgrown.
Placemaker.Settings.PolishThemeOffices.D: How offices are dressed when outgrown. Off: new offices are not outgrown. A change is given to offices outgrown from now on; Redo outgrown buildings gives it to the ones already outgrown.
How industry is dressed when outgrown: Yard gives storage yards, rubble and worn ground. Off: new industry is not outgrown. A change is given to industry outgrown from now on; Redo outgrown buildings gives it to the ones already outgrown.
Placemaker.Settings.PolishLawns.Desc: An outgrow's lawn grows to its new fences, around driveways and paving. Off: only the fences and hedges are joined.
Placemaker.Settings.PolishPaintedGardens: How many outgrows are painted (lush ground with soft edges) instead of keeping lawns: their own grass is tucked away and the whole outgrow is painted, paving kept. Natural and Yard buildings are painted more often, Tidy ones seldom; 0 never, 100 always. A mix looks more like a real street.
Placemaker.Settings.PolishPavedFill.Desc: Shops, offices and works fill the land between them with the surface most of their ground already is (their car park or concrete), not lawn.
Placemaker.Settings.PolishPlanting.Desc: Planted beds with bushes along some of the new fences and hedges. They belong to the house and go with it.
Placemaker.Settings.PolishFeatures.Desc: Big new outgrow land gets something in it now and then: a rock garden, a sand pit, a wild corner with logs, or a bench with a flower bed. Next to industry, a storage yard with rubble, pallets and crates.
Placemaker.Settings.PolishPaths.Desc: A paved path through some big outgrows, and a walkway between some houses with a narrow gap.
Placemaker.Settings.PolishRocks.Desc: Now and then a rock by the street where two outgrows meet (never against a hedge).
Placemaker.Settings.PolishGroundPaint.De: Soft lush ground past the outgrows' edges, blending them into the land around, and worn ground along fences that face open land. Paint stays on the ground when a house is bulldozed.
Placemaker.Settings.BrushPaintOverAnythi: Paint area paints over roads, buildings, zoning and water, ignoring the stops below.
Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopRoads.Desc: The brush stops at the curb and never paints across a road.
Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopBuildings.D: The brush keeps off building lots.
Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopBuilds.Desc: Every area tool keeps off what you built with Placemaker (except the one being edited).
Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopLots.Desc: The brush keeps off parks, other mods' lots and lot areas.
Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopZoned.Desc: The brush keeps off zoned cells that have a building (or one being built). Vacant zoned land stays paintable.
Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopAllZoned.De: The brush also keeps off zoned cells nobody has built on yet.
Placemaker.Settings.BlockPaintAvoidEmpty: The brush also keeps the empty zone grid free.
Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopWater.Desc: The brush keeps off water deeper than wading depth.
Placemaker.Settings.BrushStayInBlock.Des: A Paint area stroke stays inside the block where it started.
Placemaker.Settings.BrushDrawClip.Desc: Points, Paint bucket and Road nodes outlines are cut back to free land using the stops above.
Placemaker.Settings.BrushSnapDistance.De: Painted edges this close to a curb or obstacle snap onto it; 0 = off.
Placemaker.Settings.BrushSmoothing.Desc: How smooth the painted edge is: 0 keeps the brush cells, 6 is smoothest.
Placemaker.Settings.ResetBrushRules.Desc: Puts every edge rule back to its default.
Placemaker.Settings.ClearExistingTreesAn: Removes trees, plants, props and decals inside the area when it is built, so nothing old pokes through. Buildings, utilities and roads are never touched.
Placemaker.Settings.KeepZonedBuildingsOf: Blocks the roads' zone cells under a park, plaza or other build (except its zoning cutouts), so the city cannot grow houses or shops on it. Removing the build unblocks them again. Off: the land under a build stays zonable.
Placemaker.Settings.RecoverRejectedPiece: If the game refuses some pieces, repair or leave out just those and build the rest. Placemaker tells you what was skipped.
Placemaker.Settings.OverlayPavedSurfaces: Paving, asphalt and plaza surfaces are drawn on top of grass instead of flickering with it.
Placemaker.Settings.DecalsNeverCollide.D: Leaves, stains and other ground decals lie under trees, benches and paths instead of being hidden where they overlap. Turn off if decals do not show.
Placemaker.Settings.ChargeNetConstructio: Roads and paths cost what the game charges for them, like when you draw them yourself.
Placemaker.Settings.SelectAsOneThing: Select and bulldoze as one thing
Placemaker.Settings.SelectAsOneThing.Des: Clicking any part of a built lot, park or plaza selects the whole build; bulldozing removes it all. Applies to new builds.
Placemaker.Settings.DebugBuildChecks.Des: After every build, scans the built ground for bowls, sagging roads and zoning that did not happen, and writes what it finds to the log. Slow on big builds (it pauses the game for a moment). Off normally.
Placemaker.Settings.DebugTerrainDump.Des: After every build, writes the terrain heights before and after, the water depth and the built paths and objects around it to ModsData/Placemaker/debug as a JSON file, for checking the result offline (the gallery renders it). Off normally.
Placemaker.Settings.ConfirmBulldoze: Ask before bulldozing a whole build
Placemaker.Settings.ConfirmBulldoze.Desc: Shows the game's confirmation before a Placemaker build is bulldozed.
Placemaker.Settings.AutoExcludeCollision: Only when collisions are not ignored: decorative pieces the game refuses are left out (listed in the build report) instead of refusing the whole build.
Build everything you planned, like the Anarchy mod: the game's overlap and shape checks never refuse or remove pieces of a Placemaker build. Existing buildings are never demolished.
Placemaker.Settings.SurfaceClones.Desc: Lets planned ground surfaces show on top of road decals where they meet.
Placemaker.Settings.TexturedPreviewSurfa: Shows ground surfaces in the 3D preview with their real texture. Changes how the game batches surfaces for rendering; off by default until verified stable.
Placemaker.Settings.ParkingEconomy.Desc: Parking lots built with Placemaker charge a parking fee and count as parking in the city.
Placemaker.Settings.ExperimentalParkingC: Adds an invisible service building to parking lots so they show up in city statistics. Experimental.
Placemaker.Settings.CompanionUpkeepFacto: Multiplies the upkeep of the parking lot service building.
Placemaker.Settings.ShowCursorTooltips.D: Show what a click does and the area size next to the cursor.
Placemaker.Settings.ShowGardenOutlines.D: Draws every outgrown building's outgrow as Outgrow planned it: its outline in a color of its own, a dot at every corner, edges shorter than 2 m in red, and the building's own lot in white. For checking what Outgrow decided.
Placemaker.Settings.PreviewDetail.Desc: Simple updates the preview when you let go of a slider or corner and hides small objects; Detailed updates continuously.
Placemaker.Settings.SketchStyle.Desc: Site plan draws what gets built, from above: roads, paths, lawn, trees, parking spaces and every object, roughly. Classic draws role colours and dashed lines.
Placemaker.Settings.SnapToRoadsWhenDrawi: Corners snap to the edges of nearby roads. The other snapping options are in the game's snapping menu.
Placemaker.Settings.SketchSurfaceFill.De: The sketch preview shades planned grass, paving and water with a faint tint. Turn off to see only their outlines.
Placemaker.Settings.KeepOffExistingRoads: Drawn and painted areas stop at the edge of existing roads and sidewalks, so nothing is planned on the asphalt. Entrances move to the new edge.
Placemaker.Settings.LayoutSize.Desc: Scales the layout of every area type: path loops, spacing between benches and trees, plaza and feature sizes, margins. Trees, props and path widths keep their real size; parking stalls, roads, sports fields and golf greens keep real dimensions. 50% is the default; 100% is the original, roomier layout.
Placemaker.Settings.EdgeMargin.Desc: The one gap (in metres at 100% layout size) kept between the outline and paths or layout. Objects still keep their own footprint clear of the edge.
Placemaker.Settings.ZoneGridOpacity.Desc: How strongly the zone grid shows while zoning or building roads: empty cells and zoned cells alike. 100% is the game's own look; lower makes it fainter, 0% hides it.
Placemaker.Settings.ToggleToolBinding.De: Opens or closes the Placemaker tool.
Placemaker.Settings.PrimaryBinding.Desc: Does what the main button says (next step, build…).
Placemaker.Settings.UndoBinding.Desc: Undo the last change to the area or design.
Placemaker.Settings.ExportOutgrowSetting: Saves every outgrow type and zone pick to a file (outgrow-settings.json) and shows it.
Placemaker.Settings.RemoveEverything.Des: Removes every park, plaza, parking lot and road area built with Placemaker in this city.
Placemaker.Settings.RemoveEverything.War: Remove everything Placemaker built in this city? This cannot be undone.
Placemaker.Settings.ResetDefaults.Desc: Resets these options and forgets the layer defaults you saved.
Placemaker.Settings.ResetDefaults.Warnin: Reset all Placemaker options and saved layer defaults?
Placemaker.Permanent.Paint: Ground paint, about {0} m² — stays if the build is removed.
Placemaker.Problem.NoLineWalls: The bucket needs a line wall: turn on Roads, Paths, Bike paths or Rail.
Placemaker.Problem.OnlyWallsHere: Only walls here (water, lots or zoning). Click open land.
Placemaker.Hint.PerimeterAutoClose: The gap closes itself (dashed); Next to go on
Placemaker.Settings.BucketWallRoads.Desc: Every car road (alleys, gravel, one-way, pedestrian streets) bounds the bucket's fill.
Placemaker.Settings.BucketWallPaths.Desc: Pedestrian paths split blocks like streets do.
Placemaker.Settings.BucketWallBikes.Desc: Bicycle-only paths split blocks like streets do.
Placemaker.Settings.BucketWallTracks: Paint bucket walls: rail and tram
Placemaker.Settings.BucketWallTracks.Des: Train and tram tracks at ground level split blocks.
Placemaker.Settings.BucketWallWater.Desc: The fill stops at the water's edge and keeps the side you clicked.
Placemaker.Settings.BucketWallLots: Paint bucket walls: lots and buildings
Placemaker.Settings.BucketWallLots.Desc: The fill stops at buildings, other lots and your other builds, keeping the side you clicked.
Placemaker.Settings.BucketWallZoned.Desc: The fill stops at zoned cells, keeping the side you clicked.
Placemaker.Problem.FillOnWall: That spot is a road or something else it stops at. Click the land next to it.
Placemaker.Problem.FillTooSmall: Too small to fill here. Lower Gaps to reach narrow places.
Placemaker.Hint.DrawNodes: On a road node: two in a row follow the road
Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopPaths.Desc: Points, Paint bucket and Paint area keep off footpaths.
Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopBikes.Desc: Points, Paint bucket and Paint area keep off bike paths.
Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopTracks: Stop at rail and tram tracks
Placemaker.Settings.BrushStopTracks.Desc: Points, Paint bucket and Paint area keep off train and tram tracks on the ground.
Placemaker.Settings.AreaGap.Desc: Openings narrower than this count as closed for the Paint bucket and Paint area's One block, and places narrower than it are left out. 0 = off.
Placemaker.Settings.AreaReach.Desc: How far the Paint bucket spreads from where you click. In open land it fills a circle this size.
